scope: Next.js proxy discovery, per-request browser Content Security Policy delivery, strict production style policy, framework nonce propagation, configured OIDC logout form action, and rendered public/authenticated behavior

priorDefect.staticAssumption: The root-level web proxy was believed to deliver a nonce-based CSP, with unsafe-inline retained only as a style compatibility gap.
priorDefect.observedRuntimeFailure: The first local production request returned HTTP 200 without any Content-Security-Policy header because a project using src/app did not discover apps/web/proxy.ts at the package root.
priorDefect.secondaryWeakness: The undiscovered policy also allowed unsafe-inline styles in every environment.

implementedControls: move the Next.js proxy beside src/app at apps/web/src/proxy.ts so the framework discovers it
construct the policy in one typed pure function with bounded base64/base64url nonce validation before header assembly
generate a fresh random nonce for every discovered proxy request
set the same CSP on the forwarded rendering request and final browser response
use nonce-bound script-src with strict-dynamic and no unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval
use nonce-bound style-src and style-src-attr none in production
permit form actions only to self and the normalized origin of the validated configured OIDC issuer, rejecting malformed or non-HTTPS production issuers
retain unsafe-inline styles and unsafe-eval only in non-production development for framework compatibility
keep application and shared UI production source free of style attributes, raw style elements, and dangerouslySetInnerHTML
serve a same-origin application icon so the verified page has no unrelated browser console error

covered: strict production style nonce and style-attribute denial
development-only style and eval compatibility exceptions
malformed, credential-bearing, query-bearing, and non-HTTPS production OIDC issuer rejection
configured OIDC origin inclusion for the federated logout redirect
production UI source scan for inline style and raw HTML sinks
discovered proxy response and forwarded-request policy equality

productionBuild.interpretation: The corrected bundle explicitly reports a discovered proxy; the preceding bundle did not.

directProductionResponse.header: default-src self; base-uri self; form-action self configured-OIDC-origin; frame-ancestors none; object-src none; script-src self nonce strict-dynamic; style-src self nonce; style-src-attr none; font-src self; img-src self data; connect-src self; upgrade-insecure-requests
directProductionResponse.nonceConsistency: one matching per-response nonce was observed in the CSP and rendered tags

productionBrowser.title: ReconAI — Reconciliation control desk
productionBrowser.interpretation: The local production page retained intended styling and emitted no CSP violation. This is not evidence of TLS-edge or authenticated production behavior.

covered: public and authenticated page rendering with the discovered proxy active
OIDC identity-bearing synthetic session fixtures accepted by fail-closed session validation
CSRF-validated federated logout through the configured OIDC form-action origin
developmentBrowserRegression.interpretation: Development-only unsafe-inline styles and unsafe-eval keep the Next.js/React development runtime operable; the production policy contains neither exception.

operationalImpact.developmentBehavior: Development retains unsafe-inline styles and unsafe-eval for Next.js/React compatibility; scripts remain nonce-bound, and neither exception is emitted in production.
operationalImpact.rollback: Do not restore the undiscovered root proxy or production unsafe-inline styles. If a framework-generated style regression appears, keep the discovered proxy and add a reviewed nonce-aware style path with browser evidence.

limitations: The browser exercise used local HTTP and the application production runtime, not the required TLS reverse proxy or staging topology.
No authenticated page was exercised with production Redis session revocation and production OIDC configuration.
No deployed edge/CDN header-preservation, CSP reporting endpoint, multi-page authenticated flow, or hosted browser result is claimed.
No production, staging, publication, or production-readiness result is claimed.
